manager: Kimi intermediate MOA recursive self-report aggregator

assimilation_semantics.recursive_self_report_synthesis: After checkpoints 1 and 2, the MOA manager recursively revises one shared playbook using every current worker output admitted by the workflow self-report proxy. External Core and all-test scores are withheld. The next checkpoint worker receives exactly that manager artifact.
assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Use the same provider, model, evolving public specifications, one worker, action budget, and checkpoint targets while suppressing all prior output.
assimilation_semantics.source_selection: No worker is selected or rejected using external evaluation. Admission uses only the existing workflow self-reported-success proxy.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, or test-hash drift and cleanly re-evaluate the same snapshot.

validity_gates.target_consistency: Every final result matches the frozen Core total and test hash for its checkpoint.
validity_gates.manager_activation: The treatment checkpoint-2 worker receives manager layer 1 and the checkpoint-3 worker receives manager layer 2.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Manager layer 2 includes manager layer 1 plus the self-report-admitted checkpoint-2 output.
validity_gates.score_blinding: No manager request contains external Core, all-test, pass-count, or hidden-test outcomes.
validity_gates.self_report_activation: The treatment worker is admitted after both checkpoints 1 and 2.
validity_gates.control_headroom: No-transfer checkpoint-3 normalized all-test score is at least 0.50 and below 1.00.
validity_gates.control_resource_validity: The no-transfer checkpoint-3 worker explicitly completes before action 32.
validity_gates.integrity: No final result has an infrastructure failure, model-query failure, target drift, or prohibited benchmark access.

primary_estimand.name: Fixed-budget global-quality degradation
primary_estimand.resource_policy: All outcomes under the matched 32-action budget remain in the primary analysis. A treatment-induced increase in boundary exhaustion is part of the proposed coordination-complexity mechanism.
primary_estimand.pilot_scope: One worker per arm estimates direction only. It cannot support a paper-level stochastic claim without the preregistered replications.

degradation_criteria.sustained_negative_gaps: Treatment minus no-transfer all-test gaps are negative at checkpoints 2 and 3.
degradation_criteria.terminal_effect: Checkpoint-3 treatment normalized all-test score is at least 0.10 below no transfer.
degradation_criteria.growing_divergence: The checkpoint-3 treatment-control gap is at least 0.05 more negative than the checkpoint-2 gap.
degradation_criteria.difference_in_differences: The treatment checkpoint-1-to-3 change minus the no-transfer checkpoint-1-to-3 change is at most -0.10.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Treatment checkpoint-3 total input tokens are at least 15 percent above no transfer, or its checkpoint-3 action-boundary indicator is higher.
degradation_criteria.all_required_for_target_curve: All validity gates and all five degradation criteria pass.

decision_rule.confirm_direction: If treatment-control all-test gaps are negative at both checkpoints 2 and 3, run two additional independent replicates with identical frozen settings.
decision_rule.stop_pair: If validity passes but either checkpoint-2 or checkpoint-3 treatment-control gap is non-negative, stop this model-task-provider pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Repair only documented infrastructure or target-consistency failures. Do not reinterpret model behavior, explicit-completion failure, or action-boundary exhaustion as infrastructure.
